introduction: Follow Kairvo’s request for a rotting brain and Kaervek’s stolen trinket as two independent returns, with the tomb’s keys, strange passages and sanctuary as separate exploration leads.
orientation: The surface approach enters the barren gorge. Ali carries the bone key for the dark tunnel, and a charcoal key is stocked farther inside for the sanctuary door. Native keys can break when used; key recovery, unlocking, opening and actual passage are separate events. Supplied keys and already-open routes remain possible.

Find Kairvo and ask quest, vecna, hello or hi. He describes Vecna’s preservation spell and asks for one exact rotting brain. The brain is stocked inside Gerd’s corpse-named container in the embalming room; the half-dissolved corpse creature is a separate encounter.

Kairvo’s warning explains a dangerous native route. His accepted offering checks the exact brain, without requiring an earlier conversation, a personal spell-survival record or original recovery. An exact brain supplied by another player can also fit.

Find Kaervek and ask quest, vecna, hello or hi. The torturer’s apprentice carries the exact stolen trinket. The black mass’s death can move the room’s occupants to the torture chamber, but the accepted trinket return does not require a recorded personal kill or journey.

Retrieve requested materials from containers and carry them loose before offering. A generic carved part, a corpse-named container, an equipped or held item, and either reward do not replace the requested loose material. Preparation can disappear after the material is spent; the accepted return remains recorded.

The dark portal leads into the trophy halls through native travel rules. Five statues block particular directions while present, and the bubble in space can move its occupants into the void. A command attempt, a shared opening, actual arrival and personal participation are different outcomes.

Chressan’s guardians, the altar and avatar of Death, Vecna’s helpers, the oaken staff, the changing device and other treasure are optional native stories. They do not define extra accepted local hand-ins. Lore and scripted effects need their own verified outcomes before becoming achievements.

Both liches depart after accepted returns. Their item rewards, actual departures and source replenishment remain separate consequences. The zone has no normal periodic reset, but committed epic-stone activity and custom monster rebirth can cause other renewal; a new day alone does not promise a fresh giver or material.

contacts.name: the lich of Kairvo
contacts.description: Kairvo is chained within the tomb. Ask quest, vecna, hello or hi about his request for a rotting brain. His accepted return rewards the breastplate of preservation and makes him depart.

contacts.name: Kaervek
contacts.description: Kaervek is chained within the tomb. Ask quest, vecna, hello or hi about his stolen trinket. His accepted return gives a brilliantly colored trinket and makes him depart.

contacts.name: the torturer's apprentice
contacts.description: The torturer’s apprentice carries Kaervek’s exact stolen trinket. Recovering that item and returning it to Kaervek are separate facts; an exact supplied trinket can also fit.

contacts.name: a half-dissolved corpse
contacts.description: The half-dissolved corpse is a living native encounter in the embalming room. The requested brain is stocked inside Gerd’s separate corpse-named container, rather than granted by defeating this creature.

contacts.name: the arch-lich Vecna
contacts.description: Vecna’s combat spell can drag his current opponent to the embalming room. His sanctuary, helpers, equipment and epic-stone claim are separate exploration leads; the accepted brain recipe does not check personal survival of that spell.

contacts.name: a black mass
contacts.description: The black mass’s native death event moves the room’s occupants to the torture chamber. Actual arrival, participation and trinket recovery are different facts; Kaervek’s hand-in does not require a recorded personal defeat.

contacts.name: a twisted statue
contacts.description: The dwarf-shaped trophy statue blocks the northward route while present. Its barrier is separate from either accepted return.

contacts.name: a twisted statue
contacts.description: The human-shaped trophy statue blocks the northward route while present. Passing a shared route does not prove a personal defeat.

contacts.name: a twisted statue
contacts.description: The orc-shaped trophy statue blocks the northward route while present. Native movement conditions still govern actual passage.

contacts.name: a twisted statue
contacts.description: The ogre-shaped trophy statue blocks the southward route while present. It is a creature distinct from Kaervek’s requested trinket.

contacts.name: a twisted statue
contacts.description: The dragon-shaped trophy statue blocks north and south while present. It is a creature distinct from the requested rotting brain.

contacts.name: Ali
contacts.description: Ali carries the bone key used between the gorge and the dark tunnel. Recovering a key, unlocking, key breakage, opening and crossing are separate outcomes.

contacts.name: Chressan
contacts.description: Chressan can call nearby barrow guardians for help. His encounter and the oaken staff remain optional native leads, with no additional local accepted request.

contacts.name: a barrow guardian
contacts.description: The barrow guardians answer Chressan’s call. Their combat and treasure do not create another accepted quest receipt.

contacts.name: the avatar of Death
contacts.description: The avatar of Death belongs to the shrine’s altar sequence. Descriptive altar interaction and an actual summoning are separate from the two item returns.

contacts.name: the death knight
contacts.description: The death knight is a native sanctuary encounter and a potential helper in Vecna’s fight. Its defeat and equipment are separate exploration leads.

contacts.name: a ghast
contacts.description: The ghast is another native helper in Vecna’s encounter. Combat, effects and survival require their own verified outcomes.

stories.title: Bring a rotting brain to Kairvo
stories.summary: The exact rotting brain earns the native breastplate of preservation, followed by Kairvo’s departure. Current preparation is optional; only the accepted return completes this request.

steps.text: Carry the exact rotting brain loose
steps.hint: The embalming room stocks this brain inside Gerd’s corpse-named container. Recover the exact item from that container; owning the container or defeating the half-dissolved corpse does not prepare this offering. A supplied exact brain can also fit.
Offer the exact item loose to the named lich when present. The accepted receipt records the return; original recovery, reward delivery and the lich’s departure remain separate consequences.

stories.title: Return the stolen trinket to Kaervek
stories.summary: The exact stolen trinket earns a distinct brilliantly colored trinket, followed by Kaervek’s departure. This return is independent of Kairvo’s request and does not establish a personal black-mass defeat or journey.

steps.text: Carry Kaervek’s exact stolen trinket loose
steps.hint: The torturer’s apprentice carries the requested trinket. A supplied exact trinket can also fit; the colored reward, another trinket, and nested or equipped custody do not replace the requested loose material.
Offer the exact item loose to the named lich when present. The accepted receipt records the return; original recovery, reward delivery and the lich’s departure remain separate consequences.
